description: Return deterministic text statistics: bytes, characters, words, lines, sentences, estimated_tokens (characters / 4, rounded up), reading_minutes (at 200 words per minute) and a SHA-256 hash of the exact text. Use it to size text against a context or length limit, or to fingerprint it; counts are heuristics, not a model tokenizer. Runs without network access and does not store your input. Input up to 100,000 bytes; larger input is an error.

l402_proof.description: L402 payment proof "<macaroon>:<preimage>". Omit on the first call; an unpaid call returns a 0 sat Lightning invoice and the macaroon. Pay the invoice, then repeat the call with this argument set.

text.description: Text to analyze, up to 100 KB.

name: text_analyze
